subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Thwart
solution:
The correct answer is 'Allow'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Thwart **is a verb which means to prevent (someone) from accomplishing something.
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• **Appoint **- assign a job or role to (someone).
 
• Oppose - disagree with and attempt to prevent, especially by argument.
 
• Obstruct - block (an opening, path, road, etc.); be or get in the way of.
 
• Allow - let (someone) have or do something.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that allow is the correct antonym for the word thwart.
